svg.title: HARPOR pipeline
svg.desc: A capture becomes a posed mesh through SAM 3 masks, Depth Anything 3, view selection, MV-SAM3D and a pose fit (A). An object with parts is split into links (B). An optional agent in Blender refines the mesh or sets its joints; for an object with requirements a host check tests the joints in MuJoCo, and a failed check starts a repair round (C). Physics stages turn the result upright, estimate materials with VoMP, and write MJCF, USD, URDF, optional videos and results.zip (D). The job can stop for review after view selection and after the part list.
svg.text: gives a textured mesh and a pose
and the object's name, or you type the list
then exports, renders and reviews it
a failed check gives a new agent its findings
a structural flaw gets one replan first (300 s)
first build + up to 2 repairs of 450 s each
uses the agent's GLB, else posed.glb or parts.glb,
and turns it upright on the support plane
E, ν, ρ per voxel, then mass and inertia per link
GLBs, MJCF, USD, URDF, videos and JSON records
file passed to the next step
